_comment: K2 CONCEPT-LoRA: one artist, one adapter, one dedicated concept-embedding token. Dedicated trainer (krea2/train_concept_lora.py) — NOT train.py or train_mass_lora.py. Everything (VAE latents + Qwen3-VL text hiddens) is cached to disk on first run and reused on resume, so the training loop is pure compute. The launcher (launch_concept_lora.py) copies this file into each artist's run dir with 'artist' set. parallelism is always resident/single-GPU here.
_comment_topology: Resident single-GPU: measured 35.5 GB peak at 1024px/effective-batch-4 with grad_ckpt in the chunie pilot (runs/k2-chunie-peft-inflight). The launcher sets 'device' per artist.
_comment_ckpt: Base DiT = the full-FT step-49600 backbone (same one the v2 banks and slot sweeps use).
_comment_lora: Rank 16 (knob; pilot used 8, banks 32). The concept embedder (tagembed.*) is excluded from LoRA and trained directly.
_comment_optim: Lion, production-validated in k2-lion runs. LR literal 1e-4 per user (short burst, cooldown present); betas per krea2/lion.py default. weight_decay 0 like the pilot's 300-step finals.
_comment_schedule: 400 total = 50 linear warmup + 300 constant + 50 linear cooldown (lr -> 0).
_comment_data: trainer_samples_v3 e621 parquet, filtered to the single artist. Caption bands drawn PER VISIT with these weights (all 5 bands).
_comment_buckets: Same bucketing rules as the shared dataloader: base 1024, step 128, ratio cutoff 2.0. Images outside the cutoff are dropped and reported in the cache manifest.
_comment_cond: uncond_ratio blanks caption AND concept token (CFG-negative parity); concept_drop_prob blanks the token alone.
_comment_timesteps: K2 resolution-aware shifted schedule, same as train.py defaults.
_comment_run: Output roots. The launcher rewrites these per artist: runs/k2-concept-lora/<artist>/{ckpts,previews,cache}.
_comment_cache: Filled in by the trainer: runs/k2-concept-lora/<artist>/cache. Deleting the cache directory forces a rebuild.
_comment_save: save_every_n_steps=0 disables intermediates; the 400-step burst saves at 100/200/300 anyway. Final at max_steps is always saved.
_comment_marker: Explicit prompt marker syntax: '<concept:chunie> male, anthro'. dataset_marker_from optionally converts a prose trigger prefix (e.g. 'by') in the dataset captions into markers at cache build; null = leave captions untouched.
